name: 会話と返信元を添える呼びかけ通知
prompt:
Create a crisp flat Japanese notification component at exactly 390×150 pixels on a pure white canvas. Use reference image 1 (native preview) as the exact source for Japanese text, layout, component geometry and typography. Use reference image 2 (original source crop) only for visual context and reference image 3 (isolated original avatar crop) as the exact avatar photo artwork. Keep the Japanese version; do not copy any English source text.

Keep the native placements: header 呼びかけ・交流のアイデア at x16 y8, 12px Meiryo Regular #6E6E6E; timestamp 1時間前 at x294 y8, 12px Meiryo Regular #6E6E6E. At x16 y42 place the exact original portrait photo from reference image 3, 36×36px with rounded-square corners matching the source crop. Do not show the green circle or the initial 山.

At x64 y37 render 山田 はるか in 14px Meiryo Bold #1D1D1D. At x64 y67 render 返信先：参考になる動画を共有します in 12px Meiryo Regular #6E6E6E. At x64 y98 render こちらもすてきです！ 佐藤さん in 14px Meiryo Regular; the sentence こちらもすてきです！ is neutral #6E6E6E and only 佐藤さん is hyperlink blue #1976D2, with no underline. Keep the divider at y138 across the full 390px width in #E8ECE9.

No tinted colors or colored backgrounds: use a pure white page, no mint avatar fill, no blue highlight behind the link, no colored card, no gradients, shadows or decoration. Use only the original portrait photo and blue mention text as described. Preserve the exact Japanese wording and compact native spacing. Do not add controls, icons, extra copy or outer margins. Return only the flat component.
reviewNotes: The original portrait, Japanese wording, neutral copy, blue mention hyperlink, and no-tint surfaces match. The avatar and text column are about 4–5px left of native bounds and divider is about 2px low; retain needs-correction for one alignment-focused pass.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。

inputReferences.purpose: Rebuild the native Japanese mention notification using the original portrait and blue hyperlink text, with all tinted surfaces removed.
